info.title: SkyQuery metadata API
info.summary: Public, read-only metadata about the SkyQuery astronomy MCP server.
info.description:
SkyQuery is a free, open-source, local MCP server and CLI that lets AI assistants query real astronomy data (SIMBAD, JPL Horizons, VizieR, Gaia, ADS, arXiv) with units and citations attached. This API describes its MCP tools and upstream data sources so agents can decide whether and how to use it. It needs no authentication. Astronomy queries themselves run locally: install with `uv tool install git+https://github.com/KarthikSubramanian07/skyquery` and run `skyquery-mcp`.

Rate limits: 600 requests per 60 seconds per client, reported in `RateLimit` and `X-RateLimit-*` headers; a 429 carries `Retry-After`.

Versioning and deprecation: the version is in the path (`/api/v1`). Within v1, changes are additive only. A breaking change ships as `/api/v2`; v1 then keeps working for at least 6 months, and its responses carry `Deprecation` (RFC 9745) and `Sunset` (RFC 8594) headers plus a `Link` with rel="deprecation" to the policy at https://skyquery-mcp.pages.dev/developers#versioning-and-deprecation.
